post.description:
Retrieves detailed information about individual company records. The request body accepts one of two resource
types, selected by the `type` field:

- `EnrichByIdRequest`: enrich directly by ZoomInfo Company ID. Pass the IDs in `id`.
- `EnrichRequest`: enrich by match criteria. Pass up to 25 entries in `inputs` (such as `name` or `website`)
  and ZoomInfo returns the best match for each. The more detail you provide, the more likely the match is correct.
  Use `requiredFields` to list the fields a match must contain.

Best practice is to first use [Search Companies](ref:companies_searchcompanies) to identify the records you want
to enrich, then enrich them with `EnrichByIdRequest`. If your workflow does not support a two-stage retrieval,
use `EnrichRequest`.

With either type, use `outputFields` to select which fields to return for each record. To see every available
output field, and whether your account has access to it, use the
[Lookup Enrich](ref:lookupenrichinterface_lookupenrich) endpoint (`filter[entity]=company` and
`filter[fieldType]=output`). If you do not have access to a field you need, contact your ZoomInfo Account Manager.

`EnrichRequest` also resolves a visitor's IPv4 address to the associated company, commonly used to identify the
companies behind website traffic. To use this path, submit `ipAddress` as the sole input for that record. If other
company attributes are included, the request is matched on those attributes instead.

Each record returned by this endpoint charges a credit to your account, unless the record is already under
management (see [Credit Usage and Limits](doc:credit-usage-and-limits)). No credit is charged if no match is found
or if the request returns an error.
